name: create_proposal_basic
note: Golden hex generated from the legacy steem-js serializer (origin/legacy @17fdf38), whose output was first validated against every committed steemutil fixture it can encode (6/6 byte-identical). Field order and the asset-typed daily_pay are confirmed by the C++ reference (libraries/protocol/include/steem/protocol/sps_operations.hpp: FC_REFLECT(create_proposal_operation, (creator)(receiver)(start_date)(end_date)(daily_pay)(subject)(permlink)(extensions)) with `asset daily_pay`) and by dsteem's serializer table. Do NOT regenerate this fixture with steemutil's cmd/gen_serializer_fixtures: its encoder detects asset fields by Go struct field name and does not list DailyPay, so it emits daily_pay as a string (0a + "10.000 SBD") instead of a binary asset.
